title: Today's Video Is About The Devil

top_liked.author: @workathomestoners9154
top_liked.text: Satan, like God, is created and can be the name of the Force in you, as good and evil.  They are archaic words we don't need anymore.  LaVey has modernized Satanism, and it is a more rational religion than Christianity or Islam.

top_liked.author: @ihatealllife
top_liked.text:
I haven't quite shaken the idea of God yet, but I outgrew the idea of the Devil quickly after leaving Christianity.
